# DENCO INDIA

> DENCO INDIA is a scientific dental laboratory based in Tamil Nadu, India, delivering precision CAD/CAM prosthetics, zirconia restorations and digital dentistry solutions to dentists, clinics and hospitals across Tamil Nadu & Puducherry. It is a B2B dental lab serving dental professionals, not a walk-in patient clinic.

## Services

- Crown & Bridge
- Zirconia Restorations
- Implant Prosthetics
- Complete & Partial Dentures
- CAD/CAM Digital Dentistry
- Digital Scanning & 3D Models

## Products

- Fixed Restorations: Crown & Bridge, Zirconia Restorations, PFM Crowns, E-Max Restorations
- Removable Prosthetics: Complete Dentures, Partial Dentures
- Implant & Custom Solutions: Implant Prosthetics, Custom Dental Prosthetic Solutions
- Digital Dentistry & CAD/CAM: CAD/CAM Digital Dentistry, Digital Dental Scanning, 3D Printed Dental Models

## Service Area

DENCO INDIA serves dental professionals across all districts of Tamil Nadu, plus Puducherry and Karaikal, through a network of dedicated area managers who handle case pickup and delivery.

## How ordering works

Clinics hand off impressions or digital scans to their area manager, or book a lab pickup directly. DENCO INDIA accepts both physical impressions and digital intraoral scans (STL files). Standard turnaround for most fixed prosthetics is 5-7 working days.

## Quality

DENCO INDIA's processes are benchmarked against globally recognised quality standards (ISO certifications). Every restoration passes multiple inspection checkpoints — model accuracy, margin fit, occlusal contacts, shade matching and surface finish — before leaving the laboratory.

## Contact

For enquiries, case quotes, or to find the area manager for a specific district, use the contact form at https://dencoindia.com/#contact or the details listed on the homepage footer.
